title: Self-hosted file transfer with jalco-drop
description: Share files, folders, pastes and screen recordings as links that open properly, stored in Neon Object Storage. Agents can upload and read them too.

environment.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
environment.description: Long random string (for example from openssl rand -base64 32) that signs in to /admin and the upload API. Keep it in a password manager.

environment.name: OWNER_NAME
environment.description: Name shown as "<name> sent you" on shared links. Defaults to Someone; you can also change it later under Settings in /admin.

environment.name: SITE_NAME
environment.description: Site name shown in the interface. Defaults to jalco-drop.

environment.name: ACCENT_COLOR
environment.description: Accent colour as a hex value such as #ff4f00.

environment.name: CODE_THEME
environment.description: Code highlighting theme, such as pierre-dark, vesper or github-dark.

environment.name: HOME_URL
environment.description: Where visitors to the bare URL are redirected. Defaults to https://www.google.com/.

environment.name: DROPS_BUCKET
environment.description: Object Storage bucket for drops. Defaults to drops.

environment.name: RATE_LIMIT
environment.description: Set to off to disable the 60-requests-a-minute limit per IP, for example in tests.
